Control_Objective: Assign clear business and technical ownership for the AI system
Control_Description: Document named business owner technical owner and data owner for the Service Operations Assistant
Evidence_Required: AI system inventory record; owner approval note
Test_Method: Review inventory owner fields and confirm owner acknowledgement
Notes: Ownership must be reviewed before production expansion

Control_Objective: Limit AI access to approved operational data sources
Control_Description: Restrict the assistant to approved SharePoint procedures Teams operations content customer service records work-order notes technician reports and vendor documentation
Evidence_Required: Access review export; approved data source list; permission group membership
Test_Method: Compare configured access to approved data source inventory
Notes: No HR files billing modification rights or unrestricted mailbox access

Control_Objective: Prevent AI from executing high-risk business actions without human review
Control_Description: Define prohibited actions including purchase approvals billing changes refunds contract changes and technician dispatch without approval
Evidence_Required: Documented prohibited action list; workflow approval record
Test_Method: Test sample prompts and workflow paths for prohibited actions
Notes: AI may recommend or prepare but may not independently execute restricted actions

Control_Objective: Require human approval before customer-facing or operationally binding outputs are used
Control_Description: Require service manager review for drafted customer emails work-order notes and suggested follow-up tasks
Evidence_Required: Approval notes; reviewed draft samples; workflow timestamps
Test_Method: Sample approved outputs and confirm human approval is present
Notes: Approval evidence should be retained with the related output

Control_Objective: Retain evidence sufficient to reconstruct AI-assisted outputs
Control_Description: Log prompts outputs source references user identity approval notes and relevant activity logs
Evidence_Required: Prompt/output logs; source references; user activity logs; approval notes
Test_Method: Review sample log records for completeness
Notes: Evidence should support later audit or incident review

Control_Objective: Ensure AI responses are based on current approved procedures
Control_Description: Review source documents and remove outdated service procedures from approved AI-accessible repositories
Evidence_Required: Source document review log; outdated document removal evidence
Test_Method: Sample source references and verify current approved versions
Notes: Document lifecycle controls should be aligned with SharePoint governance
